<section class="cba-band cba-philosophy">
The best way to learn computational biology is not by memorizing commands. It is by asking biological questions. Everything here follows from that one idea.
</section>

<h2>🧭 Choose your journey</h2>
<p>Not tutorials. Adventures. You always know where you are, and what comes next.</p>
<div class="cba-paths">
  <div class="cba-path" style="--cba-accent:#22a06b"><span class="emoji">🌱</span><div><div class="label">Beginner</div><div class="quote">"I have never touched Linux."</div></div></div>
  <div class="arrow">↓</div>
  <div class="cba-path" style="--cba-accent:#2780e3"><span class="emoji">🧬</span><div><div class="label">Bioinformatics Explorer</div><div class="quote">"I know some commands."</div></div></div>
  <div class="arrow">↓</div>
  <div class="cba-path" style="--cba-accent:#8b5cf6"><span class="emoji">🔬</span><div><div class="label">Computational Biologist</div><div class="quote">"I can analyse data."</div></div></div>
  <div class="arrow">↓</div>
  <div class="cba-path" style="--cba-accent:#f5a623"><span class="emoji">🚀</span><div><div class="label">Research Scientist</div><div class="quote">"I can answer biological questions."</div></div></div>
  <div class="arrow">↓</div>
  <div class="cba-path" style="--cba-accent:#e5484d"><span class="emoji">🧠</span><div><div class="label">AI Scientist</div><div class="quote">"I build new tools."</div></div></div>
</div>

<h2>Meet your lab</h2>
<p>You will not learn alone. The same four people show up in every story.</p>

</div>

<h2>Every module is a story</h2>
<p>The same shape every time, so it never feels random. Complete, self-contained journeys, start to finish.</p>
<div class="cba-steps">
  <span class="chip">🧩 Start with a mystery</span>
  <span class="chip">🤔 Think first</span>
  <span class="chip">💬 Story</span>
  <span class="chip">🛠 Let's do it</span>
  <span class="chip">🎉 What just happened</span>
  <span class="chip">⚠️ Common mistakes</span>
  <span class="chip">🧩 Mini challenge</span>
  <span class="chip">🎯 Key takeaway</span>
</div>

<section class="cba-band">
<h3>🧪 One lab. One story. From week one to publication.</h3>
<p>You join a lab. The data arrives. You take it all the way.</p>
<div class="cba-flow">
  <span class="node">FASTQs arrive</span><span class="sep">→</span>
  <span class="node">QC</span><span class="sep">→</span>

  <span class="node">Differential expression</span><span class="sep">→</span>
  <span class="node">Single-cell</span><span class="sep">→</span>
  <span class="node">Spatial</span><span class="sep">→</span>
  <span class="node">Publication</span><span class="sep">→</span>
  <span class="node">Reviewer #2</span>
</div>
<p style="text-align:center;opacity:0.7">Everything connects. Nothing is a random dataset.</p>
</section>

<section class="cba-band" style="text-align:center">
<h3>Teach why before how. Always.</h3>
<p style="opacity:0.85">Anyone can copy a command. We want you to know what question it answers, and why the answer matters. That is the whole difference between running software and doing science.</p>
</section>
